covariance.label: Sample length/time covariance
covariance.description: Center each board length and finishing time on its own sample mean, multiply the paired deviations, and combine their signed products. Divide by one fewer than the number of pairs to obtain sample covariance, in metre-minutes.

normal-variance-interval.label: Upper population-variance interval endpoint
normal-variance-interval.description: Square the observed sample spread and multiply by its degrees of freedom. Divide this same numerator by the upper and lower chi-square quantiles in reverse order to obtain a confidence interval for the population variance.

normal-test-power.label: Normal-test rejection probability
normal-test-power.description: Declare a positive-direction mean shift and a known common reading spread before collecting data. Independent readings per group determine the standard error of the mean difference; a fixed one-sided cutoff then separates rejection from non-rejection under the assumed shift.
